name: Director conflict of interest declarations register
summary: Each declarations round, and when a new director joins, the company secretary gets one register: who was asked, who has returned a form and who is outstanding, every disclosed interest quoted from the forms, and each one sharing a name with a current supplier, customer or agenda item, as a question for whoever decides.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own map of the work: collecting directors' and officers' conflict of interest declarations each year and when a director joins, and setting disclosed interests beside current suppliers, customers and agenda items for the company secretary.
